description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named PartialTheme within the OrangeHRM project. It encapsulates theme-related properties such as ID, name, variables, icons visibility, and banner filenames, and provides methods for construction, access, and creation from a Theme entity.

classes.name: PartialTheme
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a partial theme configuration, including identifiers, visual variables, and banner filenames, with a static factory method to create an instance from a Theme entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of PartialTheme with provided properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the theme.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the theme.

methods.name: getVariables
methods.description: Returns the variables array for the theme.

methods.name: showSocialMediaIcons
methods.description: Indicates whether social media icons should be shown.

methods.name: getClientLogoFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the client logo.

methods.name: getClientBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the client banner.

methods.name: getLoginBannerFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename for the login banner.

methods.name: createFromTheme
methods.description: Static method to create a PartialTheme instance from a Theme entity.
